title: Five9 Brings Enterprise-Grade Voice AI Agents to Europe with Built-In Trust and Governance
summary: Five9 Voice AI Agents launch in Europe with built-in trust and governance, so agentic AI can be trusted at scale.
body_markdown:
People don't follow scripts.


They change their minds. They interrupt themselves. They get distracted. They explain one thing, remember something else and ask a completely different question halfway through.


[That's normal conversation.](https://www.five9.com/blog/you-cant-script-way-people-actually-talk) And it's exactly where scripted automation starts to struggle.


For years, contact centers have worked around this by adding more branches, intents, prompts and logic.


It works for simple interactions. But as conversations get more complex, the cost of predicting and maintaining every possible path keeps climbing — until it hits a ceiling.


Agentic AI changes that equation.


Instead of predicting every path in advance, the AI can understand the goal, reason through the conversation, use the right tools and adjust as the conversation changes.


That's the shift behind Five9 Voice AI Agents.


###


### Three Pillars of Five9 Voice AI Agents


Breaking through that ceiling isn't about one feature. It requires three things working together: an AI that can have a natural conversation, reason through a task, and operate within clear boundaries.


#### Empathy and Brand Voice


Voice is personal. Customers notice when an AI sounds generic, unnatural or disconnected from the brand they're calling.


Five9 Voice AI Agents can be configured with customized voices, dictionaries, phonemes and prosody so the experience reflects the brand. Low latency, turn detection, interruption handling and built-in compliance announcements help the conversation feel responsive, not robotic.


The experience also needs to work across markets.[Five9 Voice AI Agents](https://www.five9.com/en-uk/products/capabilities/ai-agents) support regional language variants designed for the way people actually speak in different markets.


#### Autonomous Reasoning


This is where agentic resolution becomes different from a scripted flow.


Instead of following a fixed path, the AI works toward a defined goal using prompts, tools, knowledge and specialized sub-agents. Retrieval keeps responses grounded in the business's content, while connectors and write-back actions let the AI agent do more than explain what a customer should do next.


It can actually do it.


A customer might call about a billing issue, change direction halfway through the conversation, ask about a related account and then request an action. The agent can reason through those changes rather than forcing the customer back into the original flow.


#### Safety and Scale


Autonomy only works when enterprises can control it.


Five9 Voice AI Agents include identity verification, programmatic guardrails, redaction, per-turn controls, audit trails, evaluations and escalation paths. Teams can see what the AI did, understand how the interaction performed and[continuously improve it](https://www.five9.com/blog/trust-first-automate-second-key-takeaways-scaling-ai-customer-experience) .


And containment needs to mean something.


Five9 measures resolution rather than simply looking at whether a customer was deflected from an agent. That distinction matters. A call that ends because the customer gave up isn't a successful self-service interaction.


### Europe Availability


On November 3, Five9 Voice AI Agents officially arrive in Europe. The availability was announced by Five9 product leadership at Five9 CX Connect EU, bringing enterprise-grade voice AI to European businesses with the language coverage, built-in governance and controls needed to put AI to work with confidence.


Bringing Five9 Voice AI Agents to Europe isn't simply about making the technology available in another region. Enterprise CX teams need to know that the technology can operate across languages, markets and regulatory environments while still giving them control over how AI is used.


That's why regional readiness is built into the experience.


### Speaking the customer's language


Five9 Voice AI Agents is available in Europe in 10 languages, with regional variants designed for the nuances of how people communicate.


Each one is tuned and tested for quality, rather than added just to grow the count. More languages are coming soon.
That matters because multilingual support isn't simply about translating words. A voice experience needs to sound natural to the person at the other end of the call.


### Enterprise-grade trust, governance and control


The EU AI Act's transparency requirements under Article 50 became enforceable on August 2, 2026, including requirements informing people when they are interacting with an AI system.


For enterprises, disclosure is only one part of the equation. They also need to demonstrate that the AI operates within defined boundaries and that there is evidence of what happened during an interaction.


Five9 Voice AI Agents brings those capabilities together.


### Clear AI disclosure


● Administrators can enable market-appropriate notices based on where the business operates.
● Disclosure text can be configured to align with local requirements and brand voice.
● Evidence that the notice was enabled is retained for compliance and legal teams.


Disclosure is the visible part. Responsible AI isn't just about knowing what an AI agent can do. It's knowing what it shouldn't do and having controls to keep it within those boundaries.


Five9 Voice AI Agents offers built-in guardrails, automated post-call AI evaluations, LLM blinding to ensure sensitive data isn't seen or manipulated by the LLM and workflow task verification to help organizations scale AI responsibly while maintaining control.


###
Where Voice AI Makes a Difference


Voice is still the hardest channel to get right.


It's real time. It's messy. People interrupt each other. Background noise gets in the way. Customers change direction. That's also what makes voice such an important test for agentic AI.


A voice AI agent shouldn't just sound human. It should understand what the customer is trying to accomplish, reason through the complexity, take the right action, and know when it's time to bring in a person.


Here's what that looks like for one of our customers already running it in production:


“Many companies are still talking about the promise of agentic AI, but Five9 Voice AI Agents are already delivering results. In our early rollout, we exceeded our containment rate targets, reduced handle times, and delivered more consistent, human-like customer interactions,” said Ruthu Raj, VP of Architecture, IT Infrastructure and Operations at PODS. “Five9 solved critical challenges around noise handling, turn detection, and hallucination prevention, enabling reliable, context-aware conversations at scale. Just as importantly, they were a true partner in helping us move from concept to production. By year-end, we expect Five9 Voice AI Agents to handle more than 100,000 service calls this year while improving the customer experience.”
